resources.resource: Build Lead and the crew count printed in 📦 Build_Book

step.action: Confirm that the Flame Lead and Power Lead released the tower structure.
Close the tower work area to people not on the trained crew.
Remove braces and anchors only in the printed lowering sequence.
Lower each tower section only on the Build Lead's command.
step.ifThen: IF wind or communication prevents controlled movement, THEN secure the structure and stop.

step.action: Dismantle each lowered section in the printed reverse sequence.
Put every fastener, brace connection, and anchor in the tower hardware bin.
Bundle and secure structural components in their assigned transport groups.

passWhen.criterion: No fuel or energized electrical component remains on the tower.
Every structural component, fastener, brace, and anchor is accounted for and packed.
The former tower footprint is clear and MOOP-free.
